hero.title: Write better Suno-ready lyrics, faster
hero.subtitle: A lightweight workspace to structure lyrics, manage style/voice tags, and export clean text you can paste into Suno.

what.title: What is this app?
what.p1: This app helps you write and structure song lyrics specifically for Suno workflows. It keeps your sections clean (Intro / Verse / Chorus…), lets you annotate sections (e.g. “[Intro - Violin solo]”), and generates a paste-ready export.
what.p2: It focuses on speed and clarity: no clutter, no unnecessary fields, just the inputs that matter for iterative prompting.

steps.buildStructure: Build your structure, add sections, reorder them with drag & drop, duplicate a chorus when needed.
steps.writeLyrics: Write lyrics section by section, optionally adding a short instruction for a section tag.
steps.addTags: Add your Styles and Voice tags using autocomplete (press Enter or comma to confirm).
steps.copyExports: Copy the exports and paste them into Suno.
